per_question.question: The Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) policy has been amended multiple times. Which change notice is the most recent, and what did it change?
per_question.agent_answer:
I found multiple NEMT-related change notices, including a 2026 one that appears to be the newest. Next I’m identifying the underlying NEMT manual and checking its amendment history so I can tell you which notice is authoritative and whether the corpus actually describes the edits.The corpus shows two current NEMT manuals: MA-3550 and MA-2910. MA-3550’s revision header already indicates “REVISED 03/16/2026 - CHANGE NO. 04-26,” which suggests Change Notice 04-26 is the newest for that manual; now I’m checking amendments directly and reading the header/change-notice text to see whether the database actually describes the substance of the change.I found a readable section result for the 2022 change notice, but the 2026 entries are sparse. I’m pulling the 2026 change notice’s section list and the full 2022 notice text so I can compare what the corpus can and cannot actually tell us about the latest amendment.## Most recent NEMT change notice

The **most recent readable NEMT change notice in the corpus** is **Change Notice 02-26**, effective **January 1, 2026**:  
**[CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 02-26, Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/CN-02-26-fc.pdf)**.

### What Change Notice 02-26 changed
According to the notice’s **“Updates for Specific Sections”** text, it made these changes:

- In **Section V.A.2.**, it **removed the example** “regarding if no providers are not available within the community or within 30 miles of the beneficiary's pick-up location.”
- In **Section V.A.2.c.**, it **added clarification** for approving transportation requests that are **significantly greater than 30 miles**.
- In **Section XII.E.1.**, it **updated the hyperlink** to the **Office of State Budget and Management (OSBM)** website.
- In **Section XII.E.**, it **added charts** for:
  - **In-State and Out-of-State Per Diem Rates**, and
  - **In-State and Out-of-State Mileage Rates**,  
  effective **January 1, 2026**.  
  Source: **Change Notice 02-26, “B. Updates for Specific Sections”** — [link](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/CN-02-26-fc.pdf)

## Important nuance about the current manual header

The current Family & Children’s NEMT manual, **DHHS Policy MA-3550**, shows a revision header that reads **“REVISED 03/16/2026 - CHANGE NO. 04-26”** in the current manual PDF:  
**[MA-3550 NON-EMERGENCY MEDICAL TRANSPORTATION (NEMT)](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/MA-3550-.pdf)**

However, in this corpus I could **not find a readable substantive section for Change Notice 04-26** itself. So:

- **If your question is “what is the latest change number shown on the current NEMT manual?”** the answer appears to be **Change No. 04-26** for **MA-3550**.
- **If your question is “what is the most recent change notice in the corpus whose contents can actually be summarized from retrieved text?”** the answer is **Change Notice 02-26**, and the changes are listed above.

## Prior NEMT amendment with readable summary
For context, an earlier amendment for MA-3550 is **Change Notice 04-22**:  
**[CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 04-22, Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/cn-04-22.pdf)**

Its retrieved summary says it:
- **reorganized and updated** **MA-3550.VIII, Determining Need for Transportation Services**,
- **added subsections** to make topics easier to find, and
- **moved** information about **failure to complete the assessment** from subsection A to subsection E.  
Source: **Change Notice 04-22, section “A. MA-3550.VIII, Determining Need for Transportation Services”** — [link](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/cn-04-22.pdf)

## Bottom line

**Best answer:**  
- **Most recent change notice with retrievable substance:** **Change Notice 02-26** (effective **1/1/2026**).  
- **What it changed:** updated the 30-mile example/clarification rules, updated the OSBM link, and added 2026 per diem and mileage charts.  
- **Newest revision marker on the current MA-3550 manual:** **Change No. 04-26 (revised 3/16/2026)**, but the corpus does **not reliably summarize its substantive edits**.

If you want, I can next trace **whether 02-26 applies to MA-2910, MA-3550, or both**, and lay out the current **nearest provider / over-30-miles** rules in the live manual text.
